message.content: According to their conversation on July 31st, 2026, Hailey Johnson plans to host a bread-tasting event at the bakery. She seeks Li Hua's assistance in gathering feedback from their customers during the event. Specifically, Hailey Johnson mentions that she will need Li Hua to chat with customers and collect their thoughts on the different bread varieties, potentially noting down their favorite ones. This aligns with the description of the event as a "bread-tasting event" hosted by Hailey Johnson at her bakery, where she invites Li Hua to sample the new bread recipes and gather feedback from customers.
